_about: Solutions.html card photos (scripts/build-solutions-index.py). Owner rule Oct 19 2026: no photo appears on more than one card. 'keep' = which card keeps a photo that several solution pages share (any other card loses it); 'photos' = a different real, on-topic photo for a card that lost its shared one (master untouched on R2 under images/sol-cards/, credited with its ID); a card that lost its photo and is not listed here shows no photo. Duplicates are found by image content too (same picture under two file names).
